root: ^Loras: Let me have a good look at you... you're no student... what are you doing here?
^Cacildes: Bartolomeu sent me to find you... he said he owes you a beer.
^Loras: Bartolomeu... still breathing, eh? The rascal. You must be out of your mind to come to this place... are you here to stop Vella?
^Loras: Aye. She’s the one who brought the College to ruin... this island... the curse that haunts it... it’s all her doing...
^Loras: Aye. When night falls, the waters turn to blood... she surrendered to the dark arts and raised a hidden city here,
^ meant to lure brilliant minds from every corner of the world.
^Loras: But once you find that city, you never leave. You become trapped, slowly losing yourself to madness... while she feeds upon your power.
^Loras: That’s why we must find this city—and destroy her. You and me. What do you say?
^If she’s so powerful, do we even stand a chance?

c-1: ^Loras: We might. You’ve made it this far, haven’t you? It can’t have been easy. Only a resourceful warrior could survive this place.
^Cacildes: Alright... you drive a hard bargain.

PROGRESS: ^Loras: Then it’s settled. Let’s return to the surface and see if Bartolomeu has learned the city’s location. There’s nothing left for us here.
